reset.darkmusic.title: Reset DarkMusic?
reset.darkmusic.help: Restore default settings and clear download history. Music and playlists are kept.
reset.darkmusic.body:
Restore default settings, key binds, volume, speed, HUD layout, scale, and music folder path. Stop playback and downloads. Clear download history and caches.

Keep your music, videos, playlists, installed download tools, and configured tool paths. Clearing download history lets the same videos download again.

environment.description.off: Play the original music without environment effects.
environment.description.old_radio: Narrow, slightly distorted mono sound with the character of an old radio.
environment.description.telephone: Telephone-band mono with a clear midrange focus.
environment.description.walkie_talkie: Tight communication band, stronger saturation and nasal presence.
environment.description.vinyl: Gentle roll-off and slow pitch drift; optional impulsive crackle.
environment.description.cassette: Warm high-frequency roll-off, saturation and faster flutter; optional hiss.
environment.description.bedroom: Short, soft reflections in a small damped space.
environment.description.bathroom: Bright, close reflections and a compact resonant tail.
environment.description.concert_hall: Spacious diffuse reverb with balanced damping.
environment.description.cathedral: Large, long reverberation with a distinct predelay.
environment.description.deep_cave: Dark, long reflections with widely spaced echoes.
environment.description.tunnel: Discrete repeated echoes along a narrow reflective space.
environment.description.warehouse: Hard early reflections in a large industrial room.
environment.description.stadium: Long-distance echoes with a restrained diffuse tail.
environment.description.open_meadow: Open-air distance and tone with no enclosing room reverb.
environment.description.forest_clearing: Soft, sparse outdoor reflections; optional generated ambience.
environment.description.next_room: Muffled through-wall tone and subdued room reflections.
environment.description.distant_speakers: Reduced level and softened highs with delayed reflections.
environment.description.underwater: Strong low-pass colour and slow motion; a creative effect.
environment.description.dreamscape: Wide, modulated echoes and an airy reverberant tail.
audio.darkmusic.night.help: Soften loud parts for more even listening.
audio.darkmusic.limiter.help: Limit output peaks. Select Soft or True Peak in Advanced Audio.

progress.darkmusic.waveform_help: Show the song's waveform in the main player and HUD progress bars. Played audio uses your progress colors. Analyzes locally in the background and caches results; the normal bar appears while loading. Spectrum Only has no HUD progress bar.
waveform.style.help: Choose a smooth filled contour or rounded bars. Applies to the player and HUD.
waveform.unplayed.help: Set the color of audio ahead of the playhead. Played audio uses Progress Colors.

waveform.detail.help: More segments reveal finer changes. Narrow displays automatically reduce detail to fit.

pip.title: Picture-in-Picture
pip.settings.help: Watch a chosen window inside Minecraft. Windows 10/11 x64 only.
pip.unsupported: PiP requires Windows 10/11 on an x64 computer.
pip.platform_notice: PiP: Windows 10/11 x64 only. Not available on macOS or Linux.
pip.choose.help: Choose an open window. Capture starts only when you press Start.
pip.start.help: Capture the selected window until stopped. Closing this menu keeps capture running. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
pip.visible.help: Hide without stopping capture or releasing focus shortcuts. Stop Capture releases both.
pip.in_menus.help: Show PiP in other menus as well as gameplay.
pip.fps.help: Choose Match Monitor or a manual limit from 15 to 480 FPS. Monitor rate is read when capture starts; unavailable detection uses 60 FPS. Higher limits use more CPU, memory bandwidth and GPU uploads, without adding video frames. Change while stopped.
pip.fps.monitor: Capture Frame Limit: Match Monitor (%s FPS)
pip.monitor_unknown: Monitor refresh rate unavailable; Match Monitor uses 60 FPS.
pip.return_key: Return to Minecraft: Ctrl + Alt + F%s

pip.audio_note: Sound stays in the source application; optional audio analysis only drives the PiP spectrum.

pip.spectrum.independent: These controls affect only the PiP spectrum.
pip.spectrum.position.help: Place the spectrum above, below, left or right of PiP. At screen edges it stays visible over the video.
pip.spectrum.smoothing.help: Higher values make the PiP spectrum rise and fall more slowly.
pip.spectrum.sensitivity.help: Boost quieter application audio or reduce strong spectrum levels.
pip.audio_spectrum.help: Analyze the selected application's audio to show a spectrum beside PiP. Other audible Chrome tabs may contribute. No audio is replayed or recorded. Requires Windows build 20348 or later. Change while capture is stopped.
pip.audio_unsupported: Application audio capture is unavailable on this Windows version; video remains available.

pip.crop_invalid: Enter four percentages (left, top, right, bottom), from 0 to 100. Keep at least 5% of both dimensions.
